stories.title: When disaster strikes, AI helps responders reach people more quickly
stories.synopsis: Microsoft's AI for Good team built a tool called HASTE that uses AI to analyze satellite images, so responders can see where disaster damage is worst and send aid there faster. It helps teams pinpoint the hardest-hit regions within hours instead of weeks, and the UN's humanitarian office (OCHA) has used its data to coordinate search-and-rescue operations. Faster decisions can mean faster help for people in their hardest moments.

stories.title: Historian Says GPT-6.2 Astra Identified the Creator of an Anonymous 1808 Sketchbook in 22 Minutes
stories.synopsis: Historian Mark Humphries reports that GPT-6.2 Astra, which he tested before its public release, autonomously identified the creator of an anonymous 1808 sketchbook held at Yale's Beinecke Library. The AI did it in just 22 minutes. It's a lovely glimpse of how AI could help historians bring forgotten makers back into the story.

stories.title: AI imaging techniques for marine biodiversity research
stories.synopsis: A new review in Frontiers in Marine Science explains how AI-based imaging can help researchers study life in the ocean. It describes tools such as abundance counters, monitoring systems and discovery tools, used at a wide range of ocean depths. It is written as an introductory primer so more marine biodiversity researchers can use AI to speed up their data gathering.
